title: console login: with email+password sign-in off and no SSO provider, the card says "Sign in with your organization's single sign-on" but shows no SSO button and no working method
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZZ5q3itDsK1WDVLyQ

立卡门: ① 用户可见的体验缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面 + HTTP，关闭邮箱密码登录后匿名打开登录页，实测）
业务理由: 管理员在设置里关掉邮箱密码登录、但还没配好 SSO 时，所有用户打开登录页看到「请用组织的单点登录」却没有任何 SSO 按钮，唯一的「改用密码」链接进去的表单又被服务器拒绝，整页没有一条可走的路；用户只能猜是系统坏了。登录页应只展示服务器公布的登录方式。
动手的读者: 拥有 `ui/packages/auth` 的 ui 车道：`LoginForm` 只在 `features.sso === true` 时选用 SSO 专属文案，邮箱密码关闭且无 SSO 时显示「无可用登录方式 / 联系管理员」一类的状态。
查重: `login single sign-on email_password_enabled false` 0 命中、`ssoEnforced emailPassword.enabled false login` 0、`Use a password instead login SSO not configured` 18（含已关）；最近邻 #25083（托管的仅 SSO 环境，已关），不是本现象。
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-l2 — 10 cards from QA run #29151 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

QA-source: #29151 · identity-auth.auth-method-matrix · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
On a stock showcase dev boot, admin `PUT /api/settings/auth {"email_password_enabled":false}`. `GET /api/v1/auth/config` then answers `emailPassword.enabled:false`, `features.sso:false`, `ssoEnforced:false`. Opening `/_console/login` anonymously shows a card reading "Sign in with your organization's single sign-on", a "Use a password instead" link whose form the server refuses (400 EMAIL_PASSWORD_DISABLED), and no SSO button.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02), console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; as admin `PUT /api/settings/auth {"email_password_enabled":false}`.
2. In a fresh browser context open `/_console/login`.
3. **Expected:** the card names only the methods the server advertises; with none, a clear "no sign-in method is available, contact your administrator" state, never an SSO instruction while `features.sso` is false.
4. **Actual:** SSO-only copy with no SSO affordance, plus a password link that is refused.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
`ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx:276-279` sets `ssoEnforced` when `config.emailPassword.enabled === false` (a "belt-and-suspenders fallback for older servers"), while the SSO button renders only for `features.sso === true` (:273). The SSO-only copy (:439-450) is chosen from `ssoEnforced` alone.
